bundle.shortDescription: Notes, documents and tasks, all local. No subscription, no telemetry
bundle.longDescription: Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only log, so nothing is lost and every change can be walked back. No account, no subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
